question: If all of the witches were thrown into modern Japan without their special abilities, what would each of them end up doing?
answer: Sekhmet wouldn’t come out of her room. Typhon would become the top dog in her elementary school, Daphne is unexpectedly good at talking normally, so she’d become a good listener at a girl’s middle school, the boys would secretly say that Carmilla is “Third cutest in the class”, and she’d be protected by the girls who would say that “You can’t just ignore her, after all”, Echidna would make a show of not enjoying being a university graduate student , and continue on through a researcher course, Minerva-tan’s philanthropy would lead her to actively participate in volunteer organizations, Satella would live in the attic at the house of the person she likes.
